notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least five charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least six mana of any color.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) you control.
